subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The sun was setting over the mountains, painting the sky with ________(energetic) shades of orange and pink.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"energetic"** means showing or involving great activity or vitality. (ऊर्जावान)

 
 
• **Example:** She is an energetic dancer who captivates everyone with her performances.
 
 
 
• **"Vibrant"** refers to something that is full of energy and life; it can also mean bright and striking in color. (जीवंत)
 
 
• **Example:** The vibrant colors of the festival decorations lifted everyone's spirits.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of '**energetic**' is '**vibrant**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reactive** (प्रतिक्रियाशील): Showing a response to a stimulus.

 
 
• **Example:** The reactive nature of the chemical was evident during the experiment.
 
 
 
• **Faded** (मंद): Having lost brightness or color.
 
 
• **Example:** The old photograph had faded over time.
 
 
 
• **Bright** (चमकदार): Giving out or reflecting a lot of light; shining.
 
 
• **Example:** The bright sun made it a perfect day for a picnic.
